description: Establish and record the working baseline BEFORE any changes, and confirm which verification gates are runnable in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox. This de-risks every later feature by pinning the exact self-audit commands and whether the frontend node_modules / Rust cargo cache are present offline. No product code changes.
steps: From the repo root /projects/agent-harbor, create ONE feature branch off main for the whole task, e.g. `git checkout main && git checkout -b feat/kiro-chat-redesign`. All later features commit onto this same branch.

Confirm frontend tooling availability offline: `ls hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo NODE_MODULES_PRESENT`. If present, capture the current green baseline: `cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run test` and `npm run build` (tsc+vite) and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` and the eslint script from package.json. Record pass/fail counts. If node_modules is ABSENT (npm registry is 403 in this sandbox), record that the frontend gates are CI-only and proceed with exhaustive manual self-review against the failure classes in context.environment_constraints.

Confirm Rust tooling availability offline for the host-verifiable crates (NOT tauri-app, which needs crates.io): `cd hybrid-orchestrator && cargo build -p providers -p orchestrator-core -p persistence -p secrets -p domain -p routing 2>&1 | tail -20`. If the cargo registry cache already has the deps, capture a baseline `cargo test -p providers -p orchestrator-core -p persistence -p secrets` and per-crate `cargo fmt --check`. If deps are unavailable offline, record that Rust gates for those crates run in CI and that tauri-app ALWAYS builds only in CI.

Read package.json scripts (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/package.json) and record the exact test/build/lint/format script names into findings, plus the Cargo workspace member list from hybrid-orchestrator/Cargo.toml, so later features invoke the correct commands.
Record in findings the definitive list of runnable-in-sandbox vs CI-only gates for this task.
acceptance_criteria: A single feature branch off main exists and is checked out.

findings records: (a) whether frontend node_modules is present and the exact npm test/build/lint/format script names; (b) whether the host-verifiable Rust crates build/test offline; (c) that tauri-app and web-search live calls are CI/user-only; (d) the baseline test result (green) or an explicit note that the gate is CI-only.
No product source files are modified in this feature (branch creation + investigation only).
verification: Run the frontend test + build + prettier + eslint scripts if node_modules is present and confirm they pass on the untouched baseline; otherwise document them as CI-only.
Run `cargo build`/`cargo test`/`cargo fmt --check` for the host-verifiable crates if the cargo cache is present; otherwise document as CI-only.
`git branch --show-current` reports the new feature branch and `git status` shows a clean tree (no product changes).
findings:
BRANCH: created `feat/kiro-chat-redesign` off main (main was at 68ce1ad, v0.7.4, clean tree). This is the single branch for the whole task; all later features commit onto it. `git branch --show-current` => feat/kiro-chat-redesign. Working tree clean except the untracked .agents/tasks/task-kiro-chat-redesign/ dir (no product source touched).

FRONTEND TOOLING: node_modules is ABSENT (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/node_modules missing; .bin empty). npm/npx installs are blocked (npm registry 403 in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox). Therefore ALL frontend gates are CI-ONLY here. Exact package.json (frontend/package.json v0.7.4) script names to invoke in CI / on the user's machine:
  - test:   `npm run test`         (vitest run)
  - build:  `npm run build`        (tsc && vite build)
  - lint:   `npm run lint`         (eslint .)
  - format(write): `npm run format`       (prettier --write .)
  - format(check): `npm run format:check` (prettier --check .)  [equivalently `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` once deps exist]
Baseline for these is CI-only (could not run offline); rely on exhaustive manual self-review against context.environment_constraints failure classes.

RUST TOOLING: cargo 1.92.0 present; target/ present; a cargo registry INDEX cache exists (~/.cargo/registry/cache/index.crates.io-...) BUT it does NOT contain the resolved dependency crates for the excluded manifests. The workspace Cargo.toml now has `members = []` and EVERY crate is under `[workspace] exclude` (domain, engine, mcp-client, orchestrator-core, persistence, providers, routing, secrets, tauri-app), so no crate is in the workspace Cargo.lock. Probed each host-verifiable crate via `cargo build --manifest-path crates/<c>/Cargo.toml --offline`:
  - domain -> `no matching package named chrono`
  - secrets -> `no matching package named keyring`
  - providers -> `no matching package named async-trait`
  - orchestrator-core -> `no matching package named chrono`
  - persistence -> `no matching package named chrono`
  - routing -> `no matching package named async-trait`
  cargo clippy fails identically (needs dep resolution). => cargo build / test / clippy are CI-ONLY for ALL crates in this sandbox. tauri-app is ALWAYS CI-only (needs `tauri` from crates.io). Web-search + LAN model-sharing LIVE behavior are also CI/user-only (no network / no live endpoints); they must be unit-tested with mocked HTTP (wiremock) offline.
  RUNNABLE OFFLINE: `cargo fmt --check --manifest-path crates/<c>/Cargo.toml` PASSED for all six host-verifiable crates (domain, secrets, providers, orchestrator-core, persistence, routing) - fmt needs no dep resolution. This is the ONE Rust gate runnable in-sandbox. IMPORTANT: format PER-CRATE with --manifest-path, never `cargo fmt --all`.

CARGO WORKSPACE MEMBER LIST (hybrid-orchestrator/Cargo.toml): members = [] (empty by design). exclude = [domain, engine, mcp-client, orchestrator-core, persistence, providers, routing, secrets, tauri-app]. workspace.package version 0.7.4, edition 2021. Centralized workspace.dependencies exist but excluded crates pin concrete literals in their own manifests (an excluded crate cannot inherit `{ workspace = true }`). Any new crate deps for later features must be pinned as literals in that crate's own Cargo.toml, kept in sync with the workspace.dependencies table.

GATE MATRIX for this task:
  RUNNABLE IN SANDBOX: per-crate `cargo fmt --check --manifest-path crates/<c>/Cargo.toml` (all crates); manual/static self-review; git branch/status.
  CI-ONLY (or user's machine): cargo build/test/clippy (-D warnings) per crate via --manifest-path on ubuntu/macOS/windows; tauri-app build; frontend npm run test/build/lint/format:check; live web-search calls; live LAN discovery + model sharing behavior. Web search & LAN must be proven offline via mocked HTTP (wiremock) unit tests, gated behind the composer toggle, degrading to a VISIBLE non-fatal notice (never a silent hang).

NO PRODUCT SOURCE MODIFIED in FEAT-001 (branch creation + investigation only).
